_comment: NPC conversations (docs/QUESTS.md 'Conversations'). mob template id: {start: node, nodes: {node: {text, responses: [{text, goto: node} or {text, action: end | wares | faction:<id>:<amount> | give:<item> | trade:blacksmith|outfitter|artificer (sets the crafting trade)}] (at most 5)}}}. A response with neither goto nor action ends the conversation. "requires_flag": a flag the player must have earned (a parley reward "flag") before the response shows. faction and give rewards are paid once per character. Placeholder data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md).

hello.text: Keep your wits about you, traveler. The Wastes are not kind to the careless.

responses.text: Any dangers I should know about?
Orin says I can be trusted.

place.text: The Sundering Wastes. Thestra keeps this camp so caravans have somewhere to rest. Orin trades, Garret hands out work, and Veyla trains anyone with a blade.

responses.text: Any dangers I should know about?

dangers.text: Canyon widows in the rocks to the west, and robed wanderers who pester the merchants. Thin the wanderers out and the camp will remember it.

responses.text: I'll keep an eye out. (+ camp standing)

trusted.text: Does he now? Then hear this: the widows nest in the canyon past the dead trees. Clear them and the camp will owe you.

hello.text: Every crafter in this camp started at my forge. Have you settled on a trade yet?

blacksmith.text: Armor and weapons, then. The forge will teach you patience.

outfitter.text: Tailors and leatherworkers keep this camp clothed.

artificer.text: Carpentry and stonework. Someone has to build the camp.
